title: Prove exact snapshot criterion for unique-write XOR sweeps (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with exact finite corroboration. An arbitrary dirty Boolean XOR sweep with distinct destinations equals its entry-snapshot map exactly when no source is read after an earlier write to that cell. Every failed guard has an explicit single-basis-input discrepancy. Some safe event ordering exists exactly when the directed update graph is acyclic.

```text
b ^= a; c ^= b   -> extra a in c; basis a=1 witnesses failure
c ^= b; b ^= a   -> exact snapshot endpoint
```

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. The additional step is the necessary condition, final-state witness and safe-ordering theorem. Read-before-write scheduling and topological sorting are standard background. Rohan Arun's PR409 and PR413 retain credit for the sufficient chronological premise in their particular rational entrance words. Jose Manuel's PR2195 and Adam Gall's PR2088 supply complete-packet and physical-snapshot context. Their words, counts and bounds were not audited or replayed.

Only `research/unique-write-xor-batching/` is added. No new kappa, physical supplier or selected assumption discharge is claimed.

## Evidence

Before, the complete-packet and private-snapshot interfaces leave the legality of a changed in-place read schedule to its caller. The new exact guard returns a proof-relevant failure witness or a safe-order certificate under its explicit unique-destination contract.

The independent full-operator census covers every ordered admitted word on one through five cells: **160,579 words**, **4,833 safe**, **155,746 unsafe** with one executed basis witness per unsafe word. A separate transitive-closure oracle checks all cycle decisions, including **141,736 cyclic words**. There are also 512 dirty two-bit payload executions, 16 malformed-input rejections and six boundary controls, including 4,096-cell chain/cycle limits and an eight-event repeated-write cancellation. Disposable missed-conflict and wrong-witness mutants both reject under optimized execution.

Both warning-strict registered commands passed locally on CPython 3.12.15, about 1.45 seconds each, below their 120-second limits. These are check durations, not a performance improvement claim. Package metadata, committed bytes/source history, official export integrity and normal/optimized read-only Git-free replay with empty PATH pass. Seven exported files preserve their bytes and modes. The verifier derives its report and file hashes; no receipt is handwritten.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/unique-write-xor-batching/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/unique-write-xor-batching/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/unique-write-xor-batching
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/unique-write-xor-batching --check-source-history
```

Use the host's CPython 3.12 path elsewhere. The scientific marker is `PASS_UNIQUE_WRITE_XOR_BATCHING`; registered replay prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal result rests on the written proof, with finite corroboration. The executable admits at most 4,096 cells, one write per cell and 256-bit payload entries. Repeated destinations and self-updates are rejected. Particular correlated input subsets can conceal a discrepancy; the theorem concerns equality on every arbitrary dirty input.

No actual GL64 packet enumerator or globally unique physical destination proof, paid routing, COPY/ERASE restoration, recursive workspace, native/compiler/ordinary/outer admission, selected cold replay or Lean build is supplied. The five selected assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

Scientific base and submission refresh are canonical main `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`, priority revision 8, selected kappa .003125804. Live overlap covered 310 open PR bodies and 5,906 Discussion records with complete pagination; sparse local notes were incomplete, supplemented by main-wide README and merged-PR searches. This does not certify novelty against arbitrary diffs or unpublished work.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19272221). Delivered scope matches the claim.

## Related open work

- [PR409](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/409) uses a read-before-write sufficient premise for a concrete rational entrance-shear construction. This proves an exact Boolean unique-write criterion and safe-order theorem; no invoice or bound is recomputed.
- [PR413](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/413) preserves that premise while relocating particular entrance gates. This gives a separate abstract guard and witnesses; its construction and numerical claims are not checked here.

- [PR6202](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6202) restricts rank-priced Lagrangian cache trees with common-coordinate terminals. This decides Boolean in-place versus entry-snapshot equality under unique writes; it computes no chart cost or common numerical quantity.

The completion refresh read this account's twelve other open PRs created since the advance CLAIM. No newer submission computes this Boolean batching criterion or its census, and no common-instance numerical disagreement was identified. No extra computations were run to check other contributions.

## Open next questions

1. Emit one named physical packet sweep, prove its global destination uniqueness and run the guard. The missing coordinate enumerator and complete routing invoice block an actual batching admission.
2. Classify one repeated-write family using full operators. Later writes can cancel the first discrepancy, so the present criterion cannot simply be extended by dropping its hypothesis.

The check list was read once after completion; run metadata confirms this exact head, completed status and success.

Hosted replay certified the registered normal and optimized finite checks. The local scientific, metadata, committed-byte/source-history and portable export checks listed above also passed. No check was deferred solely to CI. These checks do not establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance or discharge a selected framework assumption.

## Merge danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: isolated. The six-file research package has no production or selected-frontier changes.
